risks.title: Supply chain shortages and disruptions
risks.score_rationale: Risk placed first in 10-K with strong language ('materially affect', 'reduction or interruption'). Repeated multiple times with concrete examples (China, geopolitical conflicts). Industrial category weighted high as critical for production. Risk stable compared to prior year.

risks.title: Dependence on single or limited suppliers
risks.score_rationale: Explicit mention of single vendors and inability to diversify quickly. Alarming language: 'unable to diversify', 'quality issues'. Existential risk linked to critical components. High position in document and language intensity justify maximum severity.

risks.title: Geopolitical conflicts and international sanctions
risks.score_rationale: Cited multiple times with specific examples (Ukraine/Russia, Middle East, China). Strong language: 'armed conflicts', 'international sanctions', 'tariffs'. Direct impact on supply chain and logistics. Geopolitical category highly weighted in current context.

risks.title: Cybersecurity and targeted attacks
risks.score_rationale: Dedicated section with alarming language: 'increased threats', 'sophisticated attacks', 'data loss', 'ransomware'. Mention of generative AI as risk amplifier. Despite mitigation measures, vulnerability persists. Cybersecurity category critical for IT company.

risks.title: Increased competition and pricing pressure
risks.score_rationale: Risk clearly stated with competition factors (price, quality, technology). Moderate but repeated language. Less existential than others as compensable through innovation or differentiation. Intermediate position in document.

risks.title: Economic instability and difficult market conditions
risks.score_rationale: Mention of economic cycles and cyclical industries (oil, manufacturing). Concerned language: 'deterioration', 'volatility', 'reduced capital expenditures'. Direct impact on demand. Macro category important but less immediate than operational risks.

risks.title: Risks related to international operations
risks.score_rationale: Extended list of risks (exchange rates, regulations, political instability). Late position in text but dense content. Technical language without extreme urgency. Geopolitical category already well represented, so moderate relative weighting.

risks.title: Major production site disruption
risks.score_rationale: Risk clearly identified with multiple causes (natural disasters, pandemics, human error). Serious language: 'material impact', 'significant capital expenditures'. Less probable but high impact. Mention in central operational section.

ai_positioning.summary: No significant mention of artificial intelligence found in the provided text.
